fields.name: PrimaryWorkDetails
fields.fieldText:
Work Order Number: {!Get_Work_Order.WorkOrderNumber}

Account: {!Get_Work_Order.Account.Name}

Location: {!Get_Work_Order.Location.Name}

Primary Service Appointment: {!Get_Primary_Service_Appointment.AppointmentNumber}

Number of Techs: {!Get_Work_Order.MS_FSM_Number_of_Techs__c}


{!TotalNumberofSAs} valid Service Appointment(s) (Including Primary) out of a Max of {!MaxSAs} are currently associated to this Work Order

fields.name: GeneralCancelMessage
fields.fieldText:
If you would like to cancel any of the Appointments above so they do not count against the max number of Appointments allowed, select one or more above and then select 'Next' to process that update


*Note - If you make a selection, toggle below should be left in the 'Don't Add' status so calculations can be updated after selecting 'Next'

fields.name: CancelAppointmentMessage
fields.fieldText: Service Appointments may not be added as the Max number of valid Appointments related to this Work Order has been reached. If you would like to add more Appointments you will first need to cancel one or more of the above. In order to cancel you simply need to select the ones above that are relevant and then select 'Next'

validationRule.errorMessage: You cannot exceed the max of 4 valid Appointments related to this Work Order

fields.name: PrimaryAptNotFoundMessage
fields.fieldText:
Additional Service Appointments may not be managed due to a Primary Appointment not being found related to this Work Order. If Line Items have not been added to this Work Order, please select the 'Add Line Items' Tab to add and a Primary Appointment will be created automatically once the first Line Item has been created.


If there is a Service Appointment in the Related List above, please refresh the screen to manage Appointments.


If this message persists after refresh or you feel you have reached this screen in error, please contact your System Administrator.
